intro.text: You've missed the last train. The platform is empty, the fluorescent lights humming in the silence. On the bench beside the ticket machine sits an abandoned bag — unzipped, like someone left in a hurry.

check_bag.text: Inside: a cracked phone, a folded map with a location circled in red ink, and a train ticket stub — tonight's date, Platform 7. You glance at the station board. This station has no Platform 7.

insets.text: Ticket stub — tonight's date — Dep. 23:47 — Arr. —

phone_on.text:
The screen flickers on. One contact pinned to the top: MIRA. Below it, an unsent message — 'I'm sorry. I had no choice. Don't let them get the—'

The message cuts off.

choices.label: Pocket the phone and study the map

call_mira.text:
She picks up on the first ring. Her voice is tight.

'You found it. Listen to me carefully — do not go to Platform 7. Leave the station right now and drop the bag in the first bin you find. Don't look back.'

She hangs up before you can speak.

study_map.text:
The map is a hand-drawn layout of this station — but it includes a section that isn't on any public plan. Past the maintenance corridor on Level B, there's a door marked with a small red 7.

Somewhere below you, there is a Platform 7.

overlays.text: She said don't. She was specific. And here is exactly where 'don't' is drawn on this map.

choices.label: Leave the station and forget this ever happened

find_worker.text:
You track down a cleaner mopping near the shuttered ticket office. You explain about the bag. He looks at it, looks at you, and picks up his radio.

'Control, I've got an unattended item at Platform 3. Calling it in.'

Within minutes the station is being cleared. You end up giving a statement to two officers who take the bag and your details. It takes two hours. The bag is never mentioned in the news.

platform_7.text:
Level B. The maintenance corridor smells of rust and old diesel. At the end, exactly where the map showed, there's a steel door with no handle — just a flat panel and a blinking red light.

You hear footsteps on the other side.

overlays.text: Mira's voice in your head: 'Do not go to Platform 7. Leave now.'
The circled P7 on the map. You're exactly where it pointed.

choices.label: You think of Mira's voice. You back away, slowly, silently.

caught.text:
The door opens before your knuckle lands a second time.

Three of them. They don't speak. One takes the bag. Another takes your phone.

The light goes red again.

overlays.text: First ring. She knew you'd find it. She knew you'd come anyway.

abandoned.text:
You drop the bag by the exit and walk out into the rain. You don't look back.

You never find out what was in it. Some nights you think that was the right call.

safe_escape.text:
You come up the stairs two at a time and push through the station doors into the cold night air.

Behind you, the lights inside flicker once and go dark.

You walk until the station is out of sight. Then you keep walking.

insets.text: You never learned what was on that platform.
